pages.title: Conceptual Containment Casing
pages.text: Housing for things that are not physical. Its plates are woven from transfinite structure and braced with formal proofs, so that what it contains is held by consistency rather than by strength. It is cold, perfectly regular, and slightly unnerving to look at for long.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Ordinary containment failed the moment I tried to compress an idea. I stitched a Transfinite Weave through Crystalline Matrix and a Category Lattice and sealed it with a Formal Proof Tree. Now the shell holds because it must, logically.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Conceptual Singularity Compressor.
